meta.title: Reduce map constant instructions
meta.body_summary: Optimize VM by removing freshConst and reusing constant registers for map/struct literals, reducing hash join register increments, and updating IR golden files.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, removed freshConst and reused constant registers for map and struct literals, and optimized hash join register increments to reduce instruction count. Updated IR golden files (tests/vm/valid/*.ir.out) to reflect the instruction changes.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Golden file updates show expected instruction reduction but no before/after counts or performance measurements.
